_comment: IdiotProof generates trading strategies — a high-stakes domain where a single LLM hallucinating a verb or mis-ordering a phase costs real money. High tier = 4-voter panel with Claude as judge, so any DSL output is cross-verified before being shown to the user. Provider ids match MindAttic.Legion's LlmProviderCatalog (Legion 20 renamed 'claude' to 'claude-api').
